#Question 3
```{r q3}
#filter down to just Chicago listings
chicago_listings = listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]

#find the maximum price within that filtered subset
max_chicago_price = max(chicago_listings$price)
max_chicago_price

#find the name of the listing that has that max price
chicago_listings$name[chicago_listings$price == max_chicago_price]

```
